verdict.rationale: Honeycomb appears to be hosted SaaS only, and nothing in the pack shows a local or self-hosted instance. A developer can get a dev setup through a free-forever plan (honeycomb-docs-13, honeycomb-docs-53) and separate environments that can be managed through the API (honeycomb-docs-11, honeycomb-docs-27), then send OTLP data there to test instrumentation and Boards. Missing for 10: a local/self-hosted or emulator instance, explicit docs on dev/test environment workflows, and independent corroboration.
